purpose: Canonical versioned artifact basket projected into role-specific runtime bundles.

authority.rule: A desired artifact is never promoted to shipped merely because it appears here; it is shipped when the compiler produces it and the release manifest installs it.
authority.negative_boundary: This document does not build, install, or execute anything. It declares.

operator.description: Invoked directly by a human or an agent on the command line. Non-supervised.

service.description: Long-running supervised daemon managed by systemd. Not invoked interactively.

privileged.description: Root-boundary bridge. Executes admitted operations behind an explicit privilege boundary. Kept separate because one binary that can run as root must not expose every other subcommand at root.

tooling.description: Development and audit tools. Never deployed to a runtime node and never present in a role bundle. A tooling artifact that grows a deployment consumer must be reclassified, not silently shipped.

runtime_seed.lifecycle: installed once through HumanAdmin bootstrap and rotated only through a separately signed seed-rotation ceremony
